Hence, the correct answer is "Wednesday".

questions.q: From which country were the Directive Principles of State Policy of the Indian Constitution borrowed?

• The Directive Principles of State Policy are a set of guidelines for the government to frame policies and laws that promote the welfare of the people and establish a just and egalitarian society.

• They are not enforceable by any court, but they are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.

Additional Information

• However, the Irish Constitution also includes Fundamental Rights that are justifiable, unlike the Indian Constitution.

• The US Constitution does not have Directive Principles, but it does have a Bill of Rights that guarantees certain fundamental rights to its citizens.

• The USSR (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics) was a federal socialist state that existed from 1922 to 1991.

• Its constitution also had a set of principles and rights, but they were geared towards promoting socialist ideals and collective ownership of property.

questions.q:

• The cell membrane is a thin, flexible barrier that separates the inside of a cell from its external environment.

• It is selectively permeable, meaning that it allows some substances to pass through while preventing others from entering or leaving the cell.

• This selectivity is achieved through various mechanisms such as ion channels, transporters, and pumps.

• Water can also move across the membrane through a process called osmosis, but it always moves from an area of higher concentration to an area of lower concentration.

Additional Information

• The lipid bilayer that makes up the cell membrane is composed of two phospholipid layers with cholesterol, a lipid component, strewn in between to maintain the proper fluidity of the membrane at different temperatures.

• Additionally, membrane proteins are present in the membrane.

• These proteins include integral proteins, which span the membrane and function as membrane transporters, and peripheral proteins, which cling slackly to the cell membrane's outer (peripheral) side and function as enzymes to promote interaction with the surrounding milieu.

• The function of glycolipids embedded in the outer lipid layer is comparable.

• Furthermore, cell membranes act as the attachment surface for a number of extracellular structures, including the cell wall, and are involved in a number of cellular activities including cell adhesion, ion conductivity, and cell signaling.

if A gives B a start of 45 m, the race ends in a dead heat,

Time taken by A = 200/vₐ

Both finish at same time,

∴ 155/vb = 200/vₐ

Putting (2) in (1) we get,

Vb = 2

Time taken by B to complete 200M race would be 175 / 2 = 87.5 seconds

Thus time taken by A would be = 87.5 - 10 = 77.5 second

A takes 77.5 seconds to run 200m.

Alternate Method

In the first case:

A runs = 200m , B runs = (200-25)m = 175m

Let A take x s to run 200m then, B will take (x+10) s for 175m

In the second case:
